# ffxf_database_credentials (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_database_credentials" "current" {
  database_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the database whose credentials to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `connection_uri` (String, Sensitive) Private connection URI containing credentials.
- `credentials_json` (String, Sensitive) Credentials response as JSON, including passwords and connection URIs.
- `public_connection_uri` (String, Sensitive) Public connection URI containing credentials, when public access is enabled.
- `users_json` (String, Sensitive) Database users and their passwords as JSON.
